column3: Close to the Hebrew; NKJV capitalizes “the Angel of the LORD” and pronouns for Him (throughout the chapter).
Close to the Hebrew; “similar drink” renders “strong drink” (also in verses 7 and 14).
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV capitalizes “Man of God” and “His”; the woman says “a man of God.”
Close to the Hebrew; “O my Lord” renders “Adonai.”
Close to the Hebrew; “wonderful” renders “pil'i,” beyond comprehension.
Close to the Hebrew; “He did a wondrous thing” renders “One working wonders,” and the clause is compressed in the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “to move upon him” renders “to stir (impel) him.”
